```{r}
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
  source(here::here("R", "load_data.R"))
))
```

```{r}
taipei_land_files <- c("a_lvr_land_a.csv")

# Fail fast with a helpful message if the file name does not exist in your loaded list.
if (!all(taipei_land_files %in% names(real_estate_data))) {
  stop(
    "These files were not found in real_estate_data: ",
    paste(setdiff(taipei_land_files, names(real_estate_data)), collapse = ", "),
    "\nAvailable files include: ",
    paste(head(names(real_estate_data), 20), collapse = ", "),
    if (length(names(real_estate_data)) > 20) " ..."
  )
}

taipei <- taipei_land_files %>%
  lapply(function(file) {
    df <- real_estate_data[[file]]

    colnames(df) <- as.character(unlist(df[1, ]))
    df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]

    df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "The villages and towns urban district",
        "main use",
        "the unit price (NTD / square meter)"
      )))
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

taipei <- taipei %>%
  filter(`main use` %in% c("住家用", "住商用", "住工用")) %>%
  rename(
    District   = `The villages and towns urban district`,
    LANDPRICE  = `the unit price (NTD / square meter)`
  )

taipei_ave_price <- taipei %>%
  group_by(District) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_price = mean(parse_number(LANDPRICE), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = "臺北市"
  ) %>%
  select(Region, District, avg_price)

taipei_ave_price

```

```{r}
taipei_pop_data <- aging_data %>%
  mutate(
    COUNTY = str_replace_all(COUNTY, "台", "臺")
  ) %>%
  filter(COUNTY == "臺北市") %>%
  select(any_of(c("COUNTY", "TOWN", "A65UP_A15A64_RAT"))) %>%
  mutate(
    A65UP_A15A64_RAT = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(A65UP_A15A64_RAT))
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Region   = COUNTY,
    District = TOWN
  ) %>%
  select(Region, District, A65UP_A15A64_RAT)

taipei_pop_data
```

```{r}
standardize_cols <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
}
```

```{r}
df_med <- bind_rows(
  medical_data$medical_center %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "醫學中心"),
  medical_data$hospital_regional %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "區域醫院"),
  medical_data$hospital_local %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "地區醫院"),
  medical_data$clinic %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "診所"),
  medical_data$pharmacy %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "藥局")
)
```

```{r}
medical_summary <- df_med %>%
  mutate(
    地址 = iconv(地址, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = ""),
    地址 = str_replace_all(地址, "台", "臺"),
    Region = str_extract(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
    Address_Clean = str_remove(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
    District = str_extract(Address_Clean, "^.+?[區鄉鎮市]"),
    Weight = case_when(
      Level == "醫學中心" ~ 10,
      Level == "區域醫院" ~ 5,
      Level == "地區醫院" ~ 3,
      Level == "診所" ~ 1,
      Level == "藥局" ~ 0.5,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Region), !is.na(District)) %>%
  group_by(Region, District) %>%
  summarise(
    Medical_Score = sum(Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    Facility_Count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

medical_taipei <- medical_summary %>%
  filter(Region == "臺北市") %>%
  select(Region, District, Medical_Score, Facility_Count)

medical_taipei
```

```{r}
taipei_core <- taipei_pop_data %>%
  inner_join(taipei_ave_price, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
  left_join(medical_taipei, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
  mutate(
    Medical_Score = replace_na(Medical_Score, 0),
    Facility_Count = replace_na(Facility_Count, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_price = if_else(is.finite(avg_price) & avg_price > 0, avg_price, NA_real_),
    Log_Price = log(avg_price),
    Log_Medical = log(Medical_Score + 1),
    Aging_Burden = A65UP_A15A64_RAT
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(Log_Price),
    is.finite(Log_Medical),
    !is.na(Aging_Burden)
  )

taipei_core
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

ggplot(
  taipei_core,
  aes(x = Aging_Burden, y = Log_Medical, size = Log_Price)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = District),      # label each dot by district
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Housing Price (log)") +
  labs(
    title = "Inverse Care Law in Taipei City: Aging, Housing Prices, and Medical Resources",
    x = "Aging Burden (Elderly Dependency Ratio)",
    y = "Medical Resource Availability (log score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

taipei_quadrant <- taipei_core %>%
  mutate(
    Price_Tier = ntile(avg_price, 3),
    Price_Tier = factor(
      Price_Tier,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("Low price", "Mid price", "High price")
    ),
    Town_Label = District
  )

x_cut <- median(taipei_quadrant$Aging_Burden, na.rm = TRUE)
y_cut <- median(taipei_quadrant$Medical_Score, na.rm = TRUE)

taipei_quadrant <- taipei_quadrant %>%
  mutate(
    Need_Level = if_else(Aging_Burden >= x_cut, "High need", "Low need"),
    Care_Level = if_else(Medical_Score >= y_cut, "High care", "Low care"),
    Quadrant   = paste(Need_Level, Care_Level, sep = " / ")
  )

ggplot(
  taipei_quadrant,
  aes(
    x = Aging_Burden,
    y = Medical_Score,
    color = Price_Tier,
    shape = Price_Tier
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = x_cut, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = y_cut, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Town_Label),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Validating the Inverse Care Law: Need vs Care with Housing Price Tier (Taipei City)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Quadrant cutoffs use medians: need = ", round(x_cut, 2),
      ", care = ", round(y_cut, 2)
    ),
    x = "Need: Elderly Dependency Ratio (Aging Burden)",
    y = "Care: Medical Resource Density (Medical Score)",
    color = "Housing price tier",
    shape = "Housing price tier"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Taipei district English lookup
district_en <- c(
  "松山區" = "Songshan District",
  "信義區" = "Xinyi District",
  "大安區" = "Da'an District",

  "內湖區" = "Neihu District",
  "士林區" = "Shilin District",

)
```

```{r}
    District = str_replace_all(District, "台", "臺"),
    District_EN = dplyr::recode(District, !!!district_en, .default = District)
  )

library(ggrepel)

med_ref_taipei <- mean(taipei_core_en$Log_Medical, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(
  taipei_core_en,
  aes(x = Aging_Burden, y = Log_Medical, size = Log_Price)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  # Linear regression WITH shaded confidence band
  geom_smooth(
    aes(size = NULL),
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    level = 0.95,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = med_ref_taipei, linetype = "dotted") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = District_EN),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Housing Price (log)") +
  labs(
    title = "Inverse Care Law in Taipei City: Aging, Housing Prices, and Medical Resources",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Dashed = LM trend with 95% CI band; Mean medical availability (log) = ",
      round(med_ref_taipei, 2)
    ),
    x = "Aging Burden (Elderly Dependency Ratio)",
    y = "Medical Resource Availability (log score)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
